audit.subject: Selection
audit.decision: Twelve recurring television landmarks; no episode-only destinations. Craig Jones’s Friday home already exists as place 200 and is not counted again.

audit.subject: Baywatch
audit.decision: Original California headquarters and Mitch’s canal house only; Hawaii, 2017 film’s Florida world and the 2026 reboot excluded.

audit.subject: Story geography
audit.decision: Banks home moved to stated Bel Air street; Casa Walsh moved to stated Beverly Hills address; Peach Pit is an explicitly approximate Beverly Hills / West LA point, not Pasadena.

audit.subject: Composite
audit.decision: New Girl’s bar has one point and separately identified exterior/interior production components.

audit.subject: Photographs
audit.decision: Photos are real source frames and site photos. Archived or undated images are labeled; no claim that every ground-level image was captured recently.
